preconditions.description: The number of employees n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of teams k is between 1 and 8000 inclusive.
The length of the team list t is equal to the number of employees n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t_i <= k for t_i in t)
preconditions.description: Each team number t_i in the list t is between 1 and k inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(s * r for s in range(1, n + 1) for r in range(1, n + 1) if all(sum(1 for t_i in t if t_i == team) <= s for team in range(1, k + 1)) and sum(1 for team in range(1, k + 1) if sum(1 for t_i in t if t_i == team) > 0) <= 2 * r)
postconditions.description: The return value is the minimum cost of renting a bus such that all employees can be transported in rides of size up to s, with the total number of rides r, where no ride contains more than two teams and the cost is s * r burles.
